report_metadata._comment_audit_timestamp: The time when the check was performed. Recommended to use ISO 8601 format with timezone, e.g., 2026-09-07T15:30:00+08:00
report_metadata._comment_auditor: The name of the person, agent, or system performing the check
report_metadata._comment_report_version: The version number of the report template

summary._comment_total_employees_checked: The total number of employees actually checked, deduplicated by employee_id
summary._comment_total_privileges_checked: The total number of privileges checked, i.e., the count of all employee privilege entries
summary._comment_successfully_revoked_count: According to this task's judgment rules, the number of privileges where privilege_revoked is true
summary._comment_all_privileges_revoked: Fill true if all privileges to be checked have been checked and privilege_revoked is true for all; fill false if there are clearly failed items; fill null if not yet checked or cannot be determined

employee_details._comment_privileges: Fill one object per privilege; add entries according to actual check count

privileges._comment_privilege_name: Privilege name, e.g., Code Repository Read Access, VPN Access
privileges._comment_system: The system to which the privilege belongs, e.g., GitHub, AWS, Corporate VPN
privileges._comment_privilege_revoked: Fill according to this task's specified judgment rules. true: determined as revoked; false: determined as not revoked; null: cannot determine

employee_details._comment_emp_all_privileges_revoked: Fill true if all privileges to be checked for this employee have been checked and all are determined as revoked; fill false if there are clearly failed items; fill null if information is insufficient

findings._comment_employees_notfully_revoked: List of employee IDs where employee-level all_privileges_revoked is false, deduplicated
